An '''Acceleration Chamber''' was a type of [[Ssi-ruu]]vi-designed weapon component. It was incorporated into the design of the [[Ssi-ruuvi ion paddle beamer|ion paddle beamer]], located in the round central structure of the weapon.<ref name="EGWT" />
